note.subject_line: Welcome to Marcus Webb: Onboarding Plan and Next Steps
note.body:
Hi Priya,

We're excited to welcome Marcus Webb to the team as an Account Executive, starting on 2026-06-28 (within 2 weeks). An intro meeting is scheduled for him on June 29th at 09:00 for 30 minutes.

I'd suggest Elena Marchetti as Marcus's onboarding buddy. With 1.3 years here, she balances experience and recent familiarity with the onboarding process. Her schedule should allow her to provide solid support.

Please find a draft 30-60-90 day plan below. It's a starting point for you to review and make any necessary adjustments to align with your goals.

Lastly, there's a manager prep checklist to ensure a smooth onboarding process.

Thanks for your attention, and feel free to make any changes you see fit.

Best,

The Onboarding Team

thirty_days: Attend team and stakeholder introduction meetings to understand EMEA team's strategies and goals.
Complete Salesforce and Gong training modules.
Review the existing client list and identify top 5 potential opportunities in the UK market.
Shadow 2-3 sales calls to learn about pitching and negotiation techniques.
sixty_days: Develop a plan to increase client engagement within the UK region.
Conduct discovery calls and qualification meetings, aiming for 10 new qualified leads.
Collaborate with Marketing to initiate a targeted campaign for mid-market clients.
Prepare and present a mini-report on UK market insights during a team meeting.
ninety_days: Close at least 2 new deals and contribute to the team's quarterly target.
Build a strategic plan for expanding presence in the UK territory.
Lead a training session sharing learnings from new deals closed with the team.
Draft a proposal for a new sales strategy initiative aimed at improving pipeline velocity.

manager_checklist: Review client list and Marcus Webb's pipeline projection.
Prepare introductory presentation for Marcus on EMEA sales strategy.
Familiarize with Marcus Webb's sales tools (Salesforce, Gong, Outreach.io).
Schedule 1:1s with key stakeholders for Marcus Webb within the first month.
Review the 30-60-90 day plan and tailor it as needed.

details.body:
Hi Marcus,

We’re thrilled to welcome you to the EMEA Sales team as our new Account Executive! Joining from London, you'll be integral to helping us drive sales and build strong client relationships across the region.

On your first day, your Dell XPS 13 will be ready and waiting for you, and you'll have immediate access to Salesforce, Gong, and Outreach.io. We've lined up an introduction meeting for you with your manager, Priya Nair, and you'll receive a warm welcome email from your onboarding buddy, Elena Marchetti. She’ll help guide you as you settle in.

We’re here to support your journey and can’t wait for you to bring your expertise to our team.

Cheers,

Your EMEA Sales Team
